prompt: A closer view than the attached image, seen from high above at a three-quarter angle: one corner of a castle courtyard with two bronze cannons behind the cream battlements, orange-roofed houses along the walls, a river and a distant castle with a blue flag across green fields in the upper right. Take only the soft painterly 2D look, the colours and the light of the attached image, and make a new picture. Every cannon is a complete bronze barrel on one wooden carriage with two wheels, standing on the stone courtyard floor inside the walls, never on a wall, a wall walk, a tower, a roof or a house, its barrel raised to about 45 degrees. Exactly one cannon fires: the nearer of the two cannons fires over the wall at the distant castle, with a bright yellow flash and one big round white smoke cloud right at its muzzle and one dark cannonball a short way out beyond the muzzle on the line of its barrel, with a faint trail back to the muzzle. No other cannon fires, no other smoke, no other ball. Rules for the whole picture: the land carries the painted tile grid in the same perspective as the buildings, its lines parallel to the castle walls. Castle walls are straight cream stone walls along the grid, with square or round corner towers, never curved walls. Keep every important subject above the lowest sixth of the picture: the bottom middle shows only grass, ground or water. Not too busy, nothing too small, and the land is not bare. No people. No text, no letters, no numbers, no title, no watermark. Soft colours, not oversaturated, not a 3D render.
